latest_release.body:
### Added
- nuxt-expert: Nuxt 4.6 skill for full-stack Nuxt apps, with references on project structure and upgrades (Nuxt 3 to 4, the Nuxt 5 compatibility flag), data fetching, server routes with `nuxt/server`, rendering (route rules, islands, lazy hydration), security (runtime config secrets, nuxt-auth-utils, nuxt-security), deployment and testing. vue-expert's Nuxt 3 reference becomes `references/ssr.md`, limited to Vue SSR without Nuxt, and vue-expert and nextjs-developer link to the new skill (closing #316)
- firebase-expert: Firebase skill for the modular JS SDK 13, firebase-admin 14 and Cloud Functions 2nd gen, with references on Firestore, Security Rules and their emulator tests, Authentication and Identity Platform, Cloud Functions, Storage with App Check and AI Logic, the Emulator Suite, and Hosting and App Hosting deploys. cloud-architect, secure-code-guardian, nextjs-developer, react-expert, flutter-expert and react-native-expert link to it (closing #217)
- flask-expert: Flask 3.1 and SQLAlchemy 2 skill for JSON APIs and server-rendered apps, with references on app structure, the database layer, REST APIs, templates and forms, authentication, testing and deployment. django-expert and fastapi-expert link to it (#323)
- CI: `notes-check.yml` and the base schema under `.handbook/base-schema/` arrive with handbook v0.5.3 and check notes front matter. The default path, `notes/**/*.md`, matches nothing here, so it passes until the repo sets `notes_paths` (#324)
- Docs site: each deploy tells search engines that support IndexNow (Bing, Yandex and others) which pages changed, so they recrawl them sooner. Only the deploy build submits, and only pages whose HTML changed since the last deploy (the first deploy submits all). The key is served once for every site at `https://jeffallan.github.io/17c975f34bbe97c32cf68c4f58503478.txt`
- Docs site: the build fails on a broken internal link (`starlight-links-validator`)
- CI: `docs-site.yml` lints and builds the docs site on every pull request and push to `main`, so a broken link or lint error shows up in review instead of at release. The workflow is shared with the other docs sites and kept in step from the same private repo as the site code
- Docs site: every page has a 1200×630 preview image (`og:image`) for links shared on social sites: the site's name beside the monogram, the page title, and the page description cut to the whole sentences that fit in 260 characters. The cards are generated at build time (`site/src/pages/og/`) with astro-og-canvas
- Docs site: every page carries a JSON-LD graph naming its author. Skill and doc pages are a `TechArticle` and the home page a `WebPage` about the repo (`SoftwareSourceCode`), each pointing at one `Person` (`https://jeffallan.github.io/#person`) declared on the author's site. It is added through Starlight's route middleware (`site/src/routeData.ts`), so Starlight's own title, description and Open Graph tags stay as they are
- Docs site: the shared light and dark theme (`site/src/components/site-style/`), delivered from a private repo that keeps the docs sites in step: the teal palette and fonts (Outfit, Source Sans 3) from the author's site, a teal-based dark theme, and the monogram before the title, linking to that site. The purple palette is retired (#285)
- Docs site: a shared footer (About the Author and Contact, the docs sites, profile links, credit line, copyright, privacy link) and a Contact call to action that opens the contact form in a dialog: under the home page's buttons, and before the first heading on skill, workflow, guide, Getting Started and Skills Guide pages. README, Changelog, Contributing, Roadmap and Privacy have none. The privacy page lists Formspree (#285)
- Docs site: the header has a Sites menu linking the author's site and both docs sites, with the current one marked. The menu (`site/src/components/site-nav/`) is shared code from the same private repo, delivered with Copier (`.copier-answers.yml`), and `handb

detail.readme: --- ## Quick Start ```bash /plugin marketplace add jeffallan/claude-skills ``` **Then, install the skills:** ```bash /plugin install fullstack-dev-skills@fullstack-dev-skills ``` For all installation methods and first steps, see the [**Quick Start Guide**](QUICKSTART.md). **Full documentation:** [jeffallan.github.io/claude-skills](https://jeffallan.github.io/claude-skills) ## Skills 70 specialized skills across 12 categories covering languages, backend/frontend frameworks, infrastructure, APIs, testing, DevOps, security, data/ML, and platform specialists. See [**Skills Guide**](SKILLS_GUIDE.md) for the full list, decision trees, and workflow combinations. ## Usage Patterns ### Context-Aware Activation Skills activate automatically based on your request: ```bash # Backend Development "Implement JWT authentication in my NestJS API" → Activates: NestJS Expert → Loads: references/authentication.md # Frontend Development "Build a React component with Server Components" → Activates: React Expert → Loads: references/server-components.md ``` ### Multi-Skill Workflows Complex tasks combine multiple skills: ``` Feature Development: Feature Forge → Architecture Designer → Fullstack Guardian → Test Master → DevOps Engineer Bug Investigation: Debugging Wizard → Framework Expert → Test Master → Code Reviewer Security Hardening: Secure Code Guardian → Security Reviewer → Test Master ``` ## Context Engineering Surface and validate Claude's hidden assumptions about your project with `/common-ground`. See the [**Common Ground Guide**](docs/COMMON_GROUND.md) for full documentation. ## Project Workflow The 9 workflow commands manage epics from discovery through retrospectives, integrating with Jira and Confluence. See [**Workflow Commands Reference**](docs/WORKFLOW_COMMANDS.md) for the full command reference and lifecycle diagrams. > [!TIP] > **Setup:** Workflow commands require an Atlassian MCP server. See the [**Atlassian MCP Setup Guide**](docs/ATLASSIAN_MCP_SETUP.md). ## Documentation - [**Quick Start Guide**](QUICKSTART.md) - Installation and first steps - [**Skills Guide**](SKILLS_GUIDE.md) - Skill reference and decision trees - [**Common Ground**](docs/COMMON_GROUND.md) - Context engineering with `/common-ground` - [**Workflow Commands**](docs/WORKFLOW_COMMANDS.md) - Project workflow commands guide - [**Atlassian MCP Setup**](docs/ATLASSIAN_MCP_SETUP.md) - Atlassian MCP server setup - [**Local Development**](docs/local_skill_development.md) - Local skill development - [**Contributing**](CONTRIBUTING.md) - Contribution guidelines - **skills/\*/SKILL.md** - Individual skill documentation - **skills/\*/references/** - Deep-dive reference materials ## Contributing See [**Contributing**](CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines on adding skills, writing references, and submitting pull requests. ## Changelog See [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for full version history and release notes. ## License MIT License - See [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. ## Support - **Issues:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jeffallan/claude-skills/issues) - **Discussions:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/jeffallan/claude-skills/discussions) - **Repository:** [github.com/jeffallan/claude-skills](https://github.com/jeffallan/claude-skills) ## Author Built by [**jeffallan**](https://jeffallan.github.io) [](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeff-smolinski/) **Principal Consultant** at [**Synergetic Solutions**](https://synergetic.solutions) [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/synergetic-holdings) Fullstack engineering, security engineering, compliance, and technical due diligence. ## Community [![Stargazers repo roster for @Jeffallan/claude-skills](https://reporoster.com/stars/Jeffallan/claude-skills)](https://github.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills/stargazers) ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=Jeffallan/claude-skills&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://www.star-history.com/#Jeffallan/claude-skills&type=date&legend=top-left) --- **Built for Claude Code** | **9 Workflows** | **392 Reference Files** | **70 Skills**
